navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, 64px tall, 2px brand-red bottom border; app icon + 'StockFlow' title left, nav links right; active link uses brand-red

page.notes: warm-oat (--color-page) background, centered content column max 960px; page__header holds app icon + page__title

card.notes: white surface, --radius-md, navy-tinted --shadow-sm, --space-5 padding; hosts stock table and detail panels

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red, sharp 0px corners, hover brand-red-hover), btn--secondary (outlined navy), btn--ghost (text-only); min tap target 44x44px

form_input.notes: persistent visible label (field__label, not placeholder-only), --radius-sm, focus ring --color-info; validation shows inline field__error naming the field

table.notes: cool uppercase header row; quantity cells right-aligned in --font-mono with tabular-nums for aligned columns

status_badge.variants: badge--in-stock (success), badge--low (warning), badge--out (error), badge--on-order (info), badge--quarantined (navy); pill --radius-pill --text-xs uppercase; state carried by BOTH text and color/shape, never color alone

empty_state.notes: line icon + teaching heading + guiding copy + a CTA (e.g. 'No stock at this location, receive an inbound shipment'); never a blank region. Also renders 'not tracked' for SKUs without batch/serial detail

toast.variants: toast--success (auto-dismiss), toast--error (persistent); fixed top-right, never shifts page layout; role=alert / aria-live

scan_zone.notes: primary barcode input; success flashes green with stock row updating in place, failure flashes red and raises a persistent error toast

app_icon.notes: warehouse brand mark at client/src/assets/warehouse.png; shown in navbar and page__header next to 'StockFlow'; favicon variant for the browser tab
